info.title: Nibblets server
info.description:
The API a Nibblets server serves to its web UI and to peer servers.

Every procedure is `POST /api/rpc/{procedure}` with its input as the JSON body, answered with `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error }`. Sign in with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: the server's owner token, a paired device's token from `POST /api/pair`, or a token Nibblets Connect minted.

post.summary: Redeems a pairing link's code for a token to send as `Authorization: Bearer`.
post.description: `createPairingLink` (or `node apps/server/src/cli.ts pair`) makes the link; its `code` query parameter goes here. Each code works once.

label.description: What to call this device. Defaults to `Browser`.

401.description: The code has expired or was already used.

post.summary: A one-time ticket for opening a WebSocket, good for 30 seconds.
post.description: Browsers can't send headers on a WebSocket, so the WebSocket endpoints take `?ticket=` instead.

post.summary: Uploads a file to attach to a message.
post.description: The request body is the file itself. Pass the returned `fileId` in `nibblets.send`'s `attachments`.

400.description: No body.

404.description: No such nibblet.

413.description: Too large, or the upload failed.

post.summary: A signed link to download a file without signing in, good for an hour.

200.description: The link, relative to the server.

404.description: No such file.

get.summary: Downloads a file, whole or a `Range` of it.
get.description: Takes either a bearer token or the `exp` and `sig` of a link from `POST /api/files/{id}/link`.

401.description: Neither signed in nor a valid link.

404.description: No such file.

416.description: The range is outside the file.

get.description: Each text frame is a JSON `LiveMessage`, apart from a bare `ping` every 25 seconds to keep the connection open.

401.description: No ticket, or it has expired.

get.summary: A WebSocket terminal in the nibblet's container.
get.description: Send `TerminalInput` messages and receive `TerminalEvent` ones, as JSON text frames. The socket closes after `exit` or `error`.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: A background task's id, to attach to it instead of a new shell.

401.description: No ticket, or it has expired.
